main_turf.surface: Turf (Kikuyu and Couch grass mixture on sandy loam base)
main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). Pioneer Park Racecourse is the premier Central Highlands racing venue in Central Queensland, located 270km west of Rockhampton. The 1,700m oval features sweeping turns and a 350m home straight. The track produces a mild early-speed bias, favoring horses that can park on or near the lead ('E' and 'P' styles). The 350m home straight is long enough for strong pressers ('P') to sustain a finish, but deep closers ('C' style) struggle if early pace is moderate.
main_turf.post_bias: MODERATE INSIDE EDGE: Inside barriers (1-5) hold a distinct edge over 1000m and 1200m sprint distances into the home bend. Over 1400m and 1610m route distances, mid-draws (5-8) are competitive as horses balance up before the back turn.

handicapping_angles.emerald_100_feature_carnival: The Emerald 100 ($40k+ Showcase Handicap, October) is the centerpiece of the Emerald Jockey Club's spring carnival. Race quality elevates significantly to High Regional/Provincial standard. Upgrade runners with proven Rockhampton, Townsville, or Mackay benchmark form (+3.5 pts class angle).
handicapping_angles.central_qld_provincial_shipper_advantage: Rockhampton (ROCK) shippers dropping from Tier 2.5 Central QLD HQ into this Central Highlands circuit carry a strong class edge. Also monitor Mackay and Townsville stables (e.g. Nick Walsh, Clinton Taylor, Ricky Vale, Jared Wehlow). Upgrade provincial-form shippers (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.summer_storm_wet_track_shifts: Emerald's Central Highlands location makes it susceptible to fast-developing heavy tracks from Queensland summer storm activity. When the track flips to Soft/Heavy mid-meeting, local mudlarkers with proven wet-track wins dominate.
